feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 May 2026 10:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 13 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure over Scandinavia, with various troughs affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, decreasing 4 or 5 in the east of the area tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, becoming isolated tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or possibly poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or North-Northwest 5 or 6 in the west of the area, but 4 or 5 in the east, becoming Northwest 4 or 5 in all waters during Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first, becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
